decisions.reason: Although this drink mix is somewhat less central than the firm's industrial technology core, it is stated to build on the established offer and the firm's strong in-house R&D and university links support learning rather than quick withdrawal.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions sit squarely in the firm's existing knowledge base, and a multi-model line in a growing, innovation-active market is exactly the kind of product absorptive capacity favors retaining and refining.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant builds on the established offer and is presented as a flagship, so a research-intensive German chemicals firm would be likely to continue developing it instead of dropping it after an early market phase.

This plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the firm's established capabilities and also a strategic focus product, so despite being somewhat more exploratory than the core offer the firm's absorptive capacity makes retention more likely than exit.
